description: Use when evaluating a bank for acquisition, partnership, correspondent banking, or competitive analysis in a local market. Returns FDIC-sourced assets, deposits, capital ratios, loan quality, and peer benchmark positioning. Example: Midwest Community Bank — $2.4B assets, CET1 12.3% (well above 6% minimum), NPL ratio 0.42% vs 0.71% peer median — strong capital position, favorable acquisition target profile. Source: FDIC BankFind synced call report data. $0.02 USDC per call.
